quests.title: Priorities First: Afterword

dialogue.section: White Weasel Thief, Maisie, Mikko, Jurva

dialogue.t: I've never seen a Weasel Thief this white before. Do you think it might be ill...?
It was full of energy just now — it even tried to snatch some food from Jurva. It doesn't seem sick to me!
Maybe it's a rare species? Linnea might know.
Whoa! It's the Mora thief who emptied Paimon's secret stash!

dialogue.sit: The Weasel Thief tries to run away, but the three kids are lightning fast. They pin it down, and after a short struggle, it gives up. You take the chance to explain what happened...

dialogue.t: So this isn't the first time it's done this? In that case, we've gotta teach it a lesson! Do something wrong, and you get punished. That's only fair, right?
But... It's just an animal. It doesn't understand what's right and wrong...

dialogue.sit: As long as it gives Paimon her Mora back, that's enough for me.
Even animals need to learn how cruel the world can be...

dialogue.t: Anyway, let's get Paimon her Mora back first. It's not like the weasel can spend it, so it should all still be there.
Yay! Hehe, Paimon's secret stash is back in business!
I wish we could keep it. That way, when Helka comes back, we can show her a rare Weasel Thief!
Huh? But it's not like we can put it to work... Stealing doesn't count! Why should it get free food for nothing?
Okay, okay, but what should we do with it...? Let's figure that out with Katya later.

quests.description: A few days later, you return to Nasha Town…
